record.title: Evaluate original stock RF records and admit the smallest supported continuation
record.intent: Use actual stock headroom and return controls to decide the next RF step.
requirements: Independently verify actual capture/request/response/source receipts, original25-slot schedule/50mV conditions/freshness, stock epoch/accepted byte and thermal lineage, unchanged default/comparison qualification and original within-arm return control. Distinguish accepted records from missing/failed prefixes and retain zero B/A2 provenance until actually acquired.

Reconcile actual restoration/owned retirement/drop statistics and any transport or waveform uncertainty. If the original range or receive assumptions fail, record the exact bench or modeling question; do not relax numerical rules, change wiring or repeat the same source attempt merely to advance.

Admit an explicitly inspected bounded native B/A2 continuation only if accepted A1, separately closed reviewed Linux native preparation, current lease/ownership and complete original4800s/2400s deadline reservations support it. Otherwise prepare the exact offline next step and state the blocking time or evidence boundary. No automatic native mutation follows from this decision.
acceptance: The actual original stock arm or its precise limitation determines a concrete next RF question within the current authorization.
